name: T3 Code
description: T3 Code is a web and desktop control surface for running coding agents on your machine. This container installs the T3 Code server plus the Codex, Claude, Grok and OpenCode provider CLIs and the GitHub CLI.

notes.text: Provider CLIs (codex, claude, grok, opencode) and the GitHub CLI ship unauthenticated. Log in on the server after first boot: codex login, claude auth login, grok login, opencode auth login, gh auth login.
Access T3 Code at http://<IP>:3773 and pair a device with the token/QR shown by the server.
